date.source: The promotion's own weekly broadcast script, posted 6 January 1999.

matches.note: Kane, in Hogan's corner, drove Spector's face into the ring post when the referee's back was turned; the referee saw it and awarded the match to Spector by disqualification, and Kane and Hogan beat Spector down afterward until Total Torture ran in.
Mick Powers evened the odds by running in on Bonnin's behalf; a masked mystery man then emerged from the crowd, knocked out Nash, and helped Bonnin make the pin.

matches.stipulation: WLC World Heavyweight Championship, four-way match
matches.note: Bret Hart, originally scheduled for the match, was found unconscious backstage near a cup of drugged juice and could not compete. Austin was beaten down and sealed inside a casket by Kane, Hogan and The Rock, who spray-painted the casket and set off a wall of flame; when the casket was reopened, Austin had vanished, and the broadcast ended without a decision. Kane retained the title by default.

evidence.source: The promotion's own 6 January 1999 broadcast script.
evidence.note: Both the Intercontinental and World Heavyweight titles are on the line.

date.source: The federation's own broadcast script, self-dated to 12 January 1999 and reposted 19 September 1999 ahead of the federation's autumn relaunch.

matches.stipulation: WLC Hardcore Championship tournament, round one
matches.note: Nash reversed a suplex attempt into a Jackknife Powerbomb for the pin.

matches.stipulation: WLC Hardcore Championship tournament, round one
matches.note: A brawl spilled to ringside; Hall used a chair to fell Bonnin before finishing him with the Outsider's Edge.
Diamond Dallas Page ran in and struck The Rock with a chair after Spector's manager's angle with Page continued from the previous week; the referee called for the bell without a decision.

Total Torture taunted Page with a personal angle involving Page's wife before Page broke free and fought both men to the outside; the match was ruled a double disqualification when Total Torture left ringside.

Hall and Nash first double-teamed and pinned The Rock together, then Nash rolled up Hall with a small package to become the promotion's first WLC Hardcore Champion; Hall raised Nash's arm afterward in a show of respect.

Bret Hart arrived late, in disguise, after being presumed missing; he and Austin fought free of the casket meant for them and sealed Hogan inside, with Hart pinning Hogan for the win. The victory made Hart the number-one contender for Kane's WLC World Heavyweight Championship.

evidence.source: The federation's own first pay-per-view broadcast script, self-dated 12 January 1999.
evidence.note: Crowns the first WLC Hardcore Champion and sets the next World Heavyweight title challenger.
